description: How many institutions hold a stock, quarter by quarter: 13F filers whose holdings tables list its CUSIP (EDGAR full-text search), with the change and a sample of holders. A fall in breadth predicted lower returns (Chen, Hong and Stein 2002).

cusip.description: Or the share class's 9-character CUSIP (037833100 for Apple).

holders.description: Filers to list from the latest quarter; default 20.

quarters.description: Quarters of 13F filings to count, newest first; default 6.

name: ownership_breadth

outputSchema.description: rows are filing quarters, newest first, with the number of 13F filers listing the CUSIP.

title: Breadth of institutional ownership (13F)
